Alphabet's capital expenditures rose from $32.3 billion in 2023 to $52.5 billion in 2024, an increase of about $20.3 billion or 62.9%. Management said the increase in purchases of property and equipment was primarily driven by investments in technical infrastructure. It also said it expects to increase technical infrastructure investment further relative to 2024, in particular to support AI products and services.
Alphabet's capital expenditures were about $32.3 billion in FY2023.
Alphabet's capital expenditures were about $52.5 billion in FY2024.
Capex increased by about $20.3 billion from FY2023 to FY2024.
Capex grew about 62.9% in FY2024 versus FY2023.
Alphabet attributed the increase to technical infrastructure: "The increase in purchases of property and equipment is primarily driven by investments in technical infrastructure." It said it invests in land, buildings, and servers and network equipment, through purchases of property and equipment and lease arrangements, to provide capacity for the growth of its services and products.
Alphabet said it expects to increase its investment in technical infrastructure, including servers, network equipment, and data centers, relative to 2024. It said this would support the growth of its business and long-term initiatives, in particular in support of AI products and services.
